title: SJF with preemption
summary: Shortest remaining time first: a short newcomer takes the CPU.
hints: Simulate one millisecond at a time: at each tick pick, among the arrived processes with time left, the one with the SMALLEST REMAINING time (ties: earlier arrival, then listed first); run it for that millisecond.
A process finishes when its remaining time reaches 0, at time `t + 1` after that tick. Waiting time = finish - arrival - duration.
